title: Fanuc post on a real 31i-A5 Robodrill: rigid tap (M29), peck cycle, G05.1 Q1 R1 - test kit and questions

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on another issue or a decision

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Goal

Check CamCraft's built-in **Fanuc** post on a real Fanuc control: a **FANUC Robodrill, 3-axis, control 31i-A5**, owned by @vilts, who also checks the Hurco post (#2573). The control has a graphic toolpath check, so each program can be checked before anything cuts.

What the owner uses on this machine: **G05.1 Q1 R1** (AI contour control), **rigid tapping**, and a turret ATC with no tool preload (T and M6 on one block).

## Open questions for the post

1. **Rigid tapping:** the post writes `G84 ... F` with no `M29`. On a 31i, G84 is rigid without M29 only when parameter 5200 bit 0 is set. Does this machine need `M29 S..` before G84? If so: a post option (or the default) that writes `M29 S..`.
2. **Peck cycle:** the post writes `G73` (chip break) for a peck drill, at `R0.` (the part top) after a rapid to Z0. Is G73 the right default, or G83 (full retract)? Should R be 1-2 mm above the top?
3. **G05.1 Q1 R1:** the post does not write it today (#616: G5.1 states no tolerance, so it only names the smoothing request in a comment). Where does the owner put `G05.1 Q1 R1` / `G05.1 Q0` (after the tool change, per operation)? That decides a post option.

## Test kit (graph check only - test tools and holes, do not cut)

Tool numbers are test numbers, T12 face mill, T13 D6 end mill, T14 D6 drill, T15 M6 tap - chosen to stay off T1, the owner's probe ("I will not face with my probe!"). Change them to your own pockets first. Each program's first comment says so.

Posted 2026-11-18 by CamCraft main (v0.24.0 code), built-in Fanuc post, generic 3-axis VMC, metric, part = a 120 x 80 x 12 mm aluminium bracket, G54 = top front-left of the stock.

- `01-two-tools.nc`: face with T12 (D10), outside contour 2 mm deep with T13 (D6): tool change, `G43 H`, G2/G3 arcs.
- `02-peck-drill.nc`: seven holes, D6 drill, peck 3 mm (`G73`).
- `03-rigid-tap.nc`: M6 x 1.0 tap on the same holes (`G84`, no `M29`).

Please report per file: "loaded OK" or the alarm number and line, plus a screenshot if the graph looks wrong.

Done means: the three answers above are recorded here; any change they need is a post option or default with a golden test; the kit loads with no alarm on the 31i-A5.
